description: Public Utilities Commision of Sri Lanka - Exemtion Order made under Section 9A of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act No. 20 of 2009 (Amended)
reasoning: This gazette content contains a legal/regulatory exemption order issued by the Public Utilities Commission under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. It establishes regulatory conditions, exemptions from licensing requirements, and compliance obligations for micro hydro electricity generation projects. The content focuses on legal frameworks, regulatory requirements, and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational structures, or other specialized categories.
